source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As your opponent's Fight phase ends, pick 1 enemy model that is visible to this unit and within 24" of it, but not from a Lone Operative unit.

Then roll a D6 for every enemy unit no more than D6" from that model. Each 4+ inflicts D6 mortal wounds on that unit.
